# 보관용 워크플로 정의입니다. 활성화하려면 .github/workflows/check.yml 로 옮겨 커밋하세요.
name: Quality checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run check
      - name: Verify Cloudflare runtime
        run: |
          npm run preview > /tmp/lions-worker.log 2>&1 &
          npm run verify:local
